Genetically modified organisms (GMOs) are a subject of ongoing public debate, with some sources citing historical concerns about potential health risks such as toxicity or allergic reactions [d1, d3]. For instance, Health Canada states that GM foods pose no more risk than non-GM foods [d5], and the FDA, EPA, and USDA in the U.S. also maintain their safety [d2]. Therefore, from a scientific and regulatory perspective, GMOs can be part of our diet without added health risk, though consumer choice and labeling remain areas of discussion [d4, d6].
